blocks.text: Japan moved to the brink of qualification for the Fiba Basketball World Cup 2027 with an 86-82 road win over Lebanon on Thursday. Josh Hawkinson led the way with 24 points and 15 rebounds, while Makoto Hiejima contributed key baskets down the stretch as Japan came back from a 51-38 halftime deficit at the Nouhad Nawfal Sports Complex.
